title: This is a must-try for Sala enthusiasts
text: Ellie was just amazing. A very experienced teacher & she knew how to make you feel comfortable in the scene. I had so much fun & can’t recommend this experience enough. If you love Salsa, this is a must-try!
author: Nancy_M

title: Ellie was a great instructor
text: A private dance lesson with Ellie. Ellie was a qualified instructor and it was great to have a lesson with her and also some advice about where to go salsa dancing afterwards.
author: Eola_A

title: Great instructor, booking agency could improve
text: Ellie was a wonderful person, dancer and instructor. I had a great time. I had trouble finding a good club after so recommend providing travelers with a sheet of good dance clubs for solo travelers with the dates, addresses and hours of operation. Also they changed the time to 8:30 from 9 pm at the last minute and I had already booked other tours and my time was cut short so would have appreciated a discount but was not offered.
author: Sonia S

title: Great experience with great group
text: Learning basic steps on salsa dance and how we empress our self to do more and talk more knowing each other make it better
author: Omar_A

title: Worth the money
text: I had such a great experience here. I was completely new to Salsa and walked into this class with two left legs. My instructor was Ellie and I cannot recommend Ellie’s salsa class enough. Whether you are a seasoned dancer or a complete novice, Ellie’s teaching style and infectious enthusiasm will undoubtedly leave a lasting impact. She is a consummate professional, a gifted dancer, and an exceptional instructor who will help you uncover the salsa dancer within you. Prepare to be enthralled, challenged, and inspired in Ellie’s class – it’s an experience you won’t want to miss!
author: Ohil_C

title: Ellie was a fantastic teacher and made our experience so enjoyable!
text: We were unsure what to expect when we went to the Salsa experience as neither myself or my mum had any previous experience. We were met by Ellie at the Salsa club, who explained a bit about the history of Salsa and where the dance originated. Ellie then went on to teach us some simple moves which she made really easy to understand and learn. We had a fantastic night and would 100% recommend this to anyone know matter what level of experience you have. A big thanks to Ellie for a great night!

title: An amazing night out with Salsa Lovers Barcelona 💃🏻
text:
I simply love the idea of Salsa Lovers Worldwide 😍 For professional reasons I travel a lot and often got frustrated trying to find out where and when there’s a chance to go dancing. Salsa Lovers puts you in touch with a local who knows the country, the city and the local Salsa community. 
After my first experience with Salsa Lovers in Athens I had the pleasure last night to get introduced to Salsa in Barcelona! We had an awesome night, got to dance a lot, made new friends, and got a lot of additional recommendations. For everyone who needs Salsa in their life or is keen to give it a try Salsa
author: Miri A
